composition.notes: September trtvideo/vs-mlrt/TAS session on one server and clean revision, with TensorRT 11.2.1.2. Two CUDA launch failures and one TAS hang were archived and retried; all 42 retained final campaign runs are valid. RealESRGAN 1080p uses five rounds and retains a vs-mlrt outlier under the 4-of-5 stability policy. A hashed vs-mlrt stream-8 OOM ceiling is not an FPS point. Diagnostics rebuilt equivalent-contract engines and are supporting evidence, not an exact decomposition of tuned throughput.
